description: Search Hacker News stories and comments by keyword, sorted by relevance or date, filtered by time window and minimum points — what developers are saying about anything. Algolia's official HN search. Returns title, url, points, comment count, author, date and the HN discussion link. Price: $0.001 per call (10 free/day; after that a payment-required result lists x402 options). Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).

days.description: Only items from the last N days. Range 1-3650. Default 365.

limit.description: How many results to return. Range 1-50. Default 15.

min_points.description: Only items with at least this many points. Default 0.

sort.description: Order by relevance or newest first. One of "relevance", "date". Default "relevance".

type.description: Stories, comments, Show HN or Ask HN posts. One of "story", "comment", "show_hn", "ask_hn". Default "story".

name: hn_search
title: Hacker News search
